entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago. It's just not what I expected.
Okay, I understand. I'm happy to help you with a return. Can you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry it up, please. I don't have all day.
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [date of purchase – 15 days prior to call].
Yeah, that's the one. So, what's the process? I need to send this smart watch back, get my money back, and be done with it.

Certainly. Our return policy is quite straightforward. You have 90 days from the date of purchase to return any item for a full refund, as long as it's in its original condition. This applies to the VeloBand Pulse as well.
90 days? Great! Because I thought it was some ridiculous short window. So, I'm good to go then?

Yes, you are well within the return window. To initiate the return, I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse securely, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process your refund.
That sounds easy enough. When can I expect the email with the label?
You should receive it within the next hour. Please check your spam or junk folder if you don't see it in your inbox.
Okay. And how long does it take to get the refund once you get the VeloBand Pulse back?
Once we receive the returned item, the refund should reflect in your account within 7-10 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for making this so easy. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. Have a great day!
